subject: SOC 2 Type II / Trust Portal Access - next steps
message_1_subject: SOC 2 Type II / Trust Portal Access - Acme Health onboarding
message_1_body:
Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the call earlier — Acme Health is moving quickly on vendor onboarding. To complete our security review we need the following from Redwood: 

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (any redaction is fine)
- Bridge letter if the report is older than 12 months
- Access to your trust portal (read-only) so our InfoSec team can download evidence
- Answers to a few quick items for our questionnaire re: HIPAA/GDPR (encryption at rest, key management, data residency)

Can you confirm when we can expect the documents and portal invite? Our target is to finish the security review by 2026-07-10 so procurement can issue the PO. If easier, feel free to loop in someone on your security/compliance team.

Thanks,
Jenna Morris
Sr. Information Security Analyst
Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com

P.S. Luke Peterson (procurement) is CC'd on next steps for contracting.
message_2_subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II / Trust Portal Access - Acme Health onboarding
message_2_body:
Hi Jenna — great to meet you today. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

1) Documents: We will upload the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter to our trust portal by end of day tomorrow (2026-07-02).
2) Trust portal: I asked Marissa (our Compliance Ops lead) to add Acme Health's security team with read-only access — they will send the invite and a short how-to.
3) Questionnaire / HIPAA: Below are high-level answers; Marissa can provide formal language for procurement/security: 
   - Encryption at rest: AES-256 by default for customer data.
   - Key management: Customer keys supported via KMS; we also manage service-side keys with role-restricted access and logging.
   - Data residency: Hosted in US regions by default; EU/APAC options available for enterprise plans.

Marissa — can you share the portal invite + upload the SOC report/bridge letter? Jenna/Luke — let us know if you prefer the report via a secure link or DocuSign for acceptance.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
message_3_subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II / Trust Portal Access - invite and uploads
message_3_body:
Hi Jenna / Luke — looping in on behalf of Aditya. 

I just invited Jenna (security@acmehealth.com) to our trust portal — you should have received an invite from trust-portal@redwood.com with a temporary link. Portal link: https://trust.redwood.com/portal/invite?token=abc123

Uploaded items (visible in the portal):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (full report)
- bridge_letter_acme.pdf (signed bridge letter)

If you prefer, I can also send the SOC report as a secure PDF via DocuSign. A couple quick notes for your engineers/security reviewers: 
- Encryption at rest: AES-256; customer-managed keys supported via AWS KMS or GCP KMS (we document integration steps in the portal).
- Access controls: RBAC + SSO (SAML/Okta) supported; audit logs retained for 1 year by default, extended retention available as an add-on.

If Jenna needs formal HIPAA attestation language or a compliance contact for a short call, happy to provide. Please confirm you have access and can download the files.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Compliance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, bridge_letter_acme.pdf
message_4_subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II / Trust Portal Access - confirm + one question
message_4_body:
Marissa — confirmed, I received the portal invite and was able to download both files. Thanks for the quick turnaround. 

One quick follow-up for our compliance docs: can you provide a 1-2 sentence confirmation that Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest (we just need that for our procurement checklist) and point us to the portal doc that outlines key rotation frequency? If you can paste the exact language you want us to use in our internal procurement notes, that would be great.

Procurement (Luke) — if we get that line, I can clear security and move to PO.

Thanks again,
Jenna
Sr. Information Security Analyst
Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com
